scope: Visual inspection of all 254 shipped registered sprite target images and all 16 translated background still containers. Sprite selection follows actual placement and fallback IDs; their containing disc files match the build report hashes. The report separately proves placed sprite pixels match their targets. Stills are decoded directly from the current disc at registered dimensions. This is asset review; it does not claim every asset was seen in every natural scene.
result: Lettering is legible within the original pixel-art style. No new overlap, clipped word or damaged neighboring artwork found. Texture-page fragments and highlight components are not standalone screens; their assembled title, file-select and exam layouts have separate runtime evidence. The tiny original roster and other retained Japanese artwork remain documented exceptions.
